08 / THE ANALYTICAL IDEAS WORKSHOP

Program a punched card.

Choose a task, add cards and start the machine. The butler will do exactly what you tell him. Even when it makes no sense.

A modern educational game inspired by punched cards. It is not a reconstruction of Babbage's machine or Ada's historical program.

Goal: get the number 10 into memory and display it with the final card.

1. Add commands

Up to 12 cards. Use the up and down buttons to reorder them. Everything works with a keyboard too.
